name: Shri Ghanshyam Tiwari
education: B.Com., LL.B. Educated at S.K. College, University of Rajasthan, Jaipur, Rajasthan
permanent_address: Matrimandir, E-183-184, Ram Path Shyam Nagar, Jaipur-302019 (Rajasthan) 302019
books: (i) Aarakshan Meri Bhumika (ii) Aarakshan, Sarvjan Hitay Sarvjan Sukhay (published in 2016)
social_activities: Took active part in the construction of the Ram temple and led a batch of kar sevaks; conceptualized the formula of 'Sarvjanhitay, Sarvjan Sukhay' for the people of economically weaker sections in the year 2022; trained at R.S.S. for three years; conferred with (i) International "UNESCO Confucius 2006" in the field of literacy and (ii) "Rashtriya Satyen Mitra Award" in the field of literacy, during his tenure as Education Minister, Government of Rajasthan; achieved a 15 percent reservation formula, 2003 for all classes on economic basis; provided employment to more than 8000 widows and abandoned women; provided employment to 1.25 lakh youths through the Rajasthan Public Service Commission; the Supreme Court also remarked on the procedure followed in the appointment -"This is the way it should be"; under the Rajasthan Education Initiative, provided free computer education to government school children by starting the project "Education: Empowering the Future" in collaboration with Microsoft in the year 2005-2006; established, a private medical and technical university in Rajasthan for the first time after independence; upgraded all girls' primary schools to upper primary schools; took initiative towards teaching of Sanskrit language through Sanskrit medium; arranged free education and free textbooks for girl students
countries_visited: U.K., Ireland, Hong Kong, China, U.S.A. and Nepal
other_information: Chairman, Sub-Committee on universalisation of Secondary Education, Central Advisory Board of Education (CABE); presided over a three-day conference on "Information and Communication Technology Education in India" under the auspices of U.N.O. in Dublin, (Ireland), 2005; responsibilities in Sangh Parivar: discharged various responsibilities in the Sangh Parivar; Leader, Vidyarthi Parishad, 1968-1972; led the first batch of 1500 kar sevaks on 22 November 1992; during the emergency, participated in a two-day hunger strike, observed by the opposition parties and volunteers in all the jails across the country; worked as a full-time worker for three years; honoured under 'Loktantrik Pakhwada' during the emergency; responsibilities and positions in student life: Mahamantri, Shri Kalyan College Sikar 1968-1970; Member, (i) Apex Body, Rajasthan University Students Union,1970-1971 and (ii) All India Convener Board; Convener and Vice-President, A.B.V.P.; President, Rajasthan Youth Union; responsibilities and positions in the organization of Bharatiya Janata Party: State Convener, Youth Union, Jansangh, Rajasthan, 1971-1977; Member, (i) All India Convenor Board, Youth Union, Jansangh, (ii) National Council of the B.J.P., (iii) National Executive, Bharatiya Janata Party, 1992-1994, (iv) Election Committee, B.J.P., Rajasthan, 1992-1994, (v) Election Manifesto Committee, B.J.P., Rajasthan, 1993, (vi) National Executive, B.J.P. 2000-2013 and (vii) Election Manifesto Committee, B.J.P. Rajasthan 2008; State Spokesperson, B.J.P., Rajasthan, 1992-1994; State Convener, Lok Sabha Elections, B.J.P., Rajasthan in 1999; President, Election Manifesto Committee, B.J.P., Rajasthan in 2008; Pradesh Mahamantri and Pradesh Adhyaksh, Democratic Front, 1977; Pradesh Adhyaksh and Mahamantri Janata Yuva Morcha, 1980; District President, B.J.P., District Sikar, 1981-1986; Pradesh Mahamantri, B.J.P. Rajasthan, 1987-1989; Pradesh Upadhyaksh, B.J.P., Rajasthan, 1989-2003
